title: Bahá’u’lláh and the New Era
textType: Book about the Bahá’í Faith by an individual author
author: esslemont
attributionNote: Bahá’u’lláh and the New Era, by John Ebenezer Esslemont: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its Publications by Individual Authors shelf.
description: Originally published in 1923, this book by Dr. John E. Esslemont—an early British Bahá’í—has been translated into numerous languages and remains a key introductory text to the Bahá’í religion. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (Publications by Individual Authors).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
